recipes.name: Dal tadka
steps: Pressure-cook the rinsed dal with turmeric and 3 cups water until soft.
Fry cumin, garlic, ginger and onion in oil until golden, add tomato and chilli powder and cook down.
Stir the masala into the dal, simmer 5 minutes and season.
Finish with a ghee tadka and coriander.
subs: Use oil only for a vegan dal

recipes.name: Dal makhani
steps: Soak urad and rajma overnight, then pressure-cook until very soft.
Cook ginger, garlic, onion and tomato in butter into a thick masala.
Add the lentils and simmer on low heat for at least 45 minutes, mashing some.
Stir in cream and garam masala before serving.

recipes.name: Rajma masala
steps: Soak rajma overnight and pressure-cook until creamy.
Fry cumin, onion, ginger and garlic until brown, add tomato and spices and cook until oil separates.
Add rajma with cooking water and simmer 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Chole masala
steps: Soak chickpeas overnight and pressure-cook until tender.
Brown onion, ginger and garlic in oil, add tomato and spices and cook into a masala.
Add chickpeas with liquid, mash a few and simmer 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Palak paneer
steps: Blanch spinach, cool and blend with green chilli.
Fry cumin, garlic, ginger and onion, add tomato and cook down.
Add spinach purée and simmer 5 minutes, then paneer cubes and cream.

recipes.name: Paneer butter masala
steps: Simmer tomato, onion, cashew, ginger and garlic, then blend smooth.
Cook the purée in butter with chilli powder until thick.
Add paneer, cream, sugar and garam masala and heat through.

recipes.name: Kadai paneer
steps: Dry-roast and crush coriander and chilli for the kadai masala.
Fry onion, ginger and garlic, add tomato and masala and cook down.
Toss in capsicum and paneer and cook 5 minutes on high heat.

recipes.name: Matar paneer
steps: Fry onion, ginger and garlic until golden and blend with tomato.
Cook the paste with spices until oil separates.
Add peas and water, simmer 8 minutes, then add paneer.

recipes.name: Shahi paneer
steps: Boil onion, tomato and cashew and blend smooth.
Cook the paste in ghee with cardamom, then whisk in curd.
Add paneer and cream and simmer briefly.

recipes.name: Paneer tikka
steps: Mix hung curd, ginger, garlic, spices, lemon and oil into a marinade.
Coat paneer, capsicum and onion and rest 30 minutes.
Skewer and grill or bake at 220 °C until charred at the edges.
subs: Vegan with a plant yoghurt marinade

recipes.name: Aloo gobi
steps: Fry cumin, ginger and onion in oil.
Add potato and cauliflower with spices, cover and cook on low heat until tender.
Add tomato and cook uncovered for 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Aloo matar
steps: Fry cumin, onion and ginger, add tomato and spices.
Add cubed potato, peas and water.
Simmer covered until the potato is soft.

recipes.name: Jeera aloo
steps: Boil, peel and cube the potatoes.
Crackle cumin in oil, add chilli and spices.
Toss potatoes until lightly crisp and finish with coriander.

recipes.name: Punjabi dum aloo
steps: Parboil and prick baby potatoes, then shallow-fry until golden.
Cook onion, ginger, garlic and tomato into a gravy, whisk in curd.
Add potatoes, cover tightly and cook on low heat for 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Bhindi masala
steps: Wash and fully dry okra before cutting.
Fry okra in oil until no longer slimy and set aside.
Fry onion and tomato with spices, return okra and toss.

recipes.name: Baingan bharta
steps: Roast brinjal over a flame until charred and soft, then peel and mash.
Fry garlic, onion, chilli and tomato.
Add the mash, cook 8 minutes and finish with coriander.

recipes.name: Mixed vegetable sabzi
steps: Fry onion and ginger, add tomato and spices.
Add the chopped vegetables and a splash of water.
Cover and cook until just tender.

recipes.name: Lauki sabzi
steps: Peel and cube the gourd.
Crackle cumin, add tomato and spices.
Add gourd, cover and cook until soft.

recipes.name: Lauki chana dal
steps: Soak chana dal for an hour.
Pressure-cook with lauki and turmeric.
Add a tadka of cumin, onion, tomato and spices.

recipes.name: Sarson ka saag
steps: Boil greens with ginger, garlic and chilli until soft.
Blend coarsely, stir in maize flour and simmer 20 minutes.
Finish with onion fried in ghee.

recipes.name: Punjabi kadhi pakora
steps: Whisk curd with 40 g besan, turmeric and 3 cups water.
Make onion pakoras with the rest of the besan and shallow-fry.
Temper fenugreek and cumin, add the curd mix and simmer 25 minutes, then add pakoras.

recipes.name: Dal palak
steps: Cook the dals with turmeric until soft.
Wilt chopped spinach into the dal.
Temper cumin, garlic, onion and tomato and stir in.

recipes.name: Yellow moong dal
steps: Cook moong dal with turmeric until soft.
Temper ghee with cumin, hing, ginger and chilli, add tomato.
Pour over the dal and simmer 3 minutes.

recipes.name: Chana dal fry
steps: Soak chana dal and pressure-cook until soft but whole.
Fry onion, ginger, garlic and tomato with spices.
Combine and simmer, finish with ghee.

recipes.name: Masoor dal
steps: Boil masoor dal with turmeric until it breaks down.
Fry cumin, garlic, onion and tomato.
Stir into the dal and simmer.

recipes.name: Kala chana curry
steps: Soak and pressure-cook the chana.
Make an onion-tomato masala with ginger, garlic and spices.
Add chana and water and simmer 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Lobia masala
steps: Soak lobia for 4 hours and pressure-cook.
Make an onion-tomato masala.
Simmer lobia in the masala for 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Soya chunk curry
steps: Soak soya chunks in hot water, squeeze dry.
Make an onion-tomato masala and whisk in curd.
Add soya and water and simmer 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Mushroom matar
steps: Fry onion, ginger and garlic, add tomato and spices.
Add mushrooms and peas.
Cook until the mushrooms release and reabsorb their liquid.

recipes.name: Malai kofta
steps: Mash paneer and boiled potato with cornflour and shape koftas.
Shallow-fry the koftas until golden.
Blend tomato, onion and cashew into a gravy, cook with spices and cream, add koftas before serving.

recipes.name: Butter chicken
steps: Marinate chicken in curd, ginger, garlic and chilli, then grill or pan-sear.
Simmer tomato and cashew and blend into a smooth sauce.
Cook the sauce in butter, add chicken, cream and garam masala.

recipes.name: Home-style chicken curry
steps: Brown onion in oil, add ginger and garlic.
Add chicken and spices and sear 5 minutes.
Add tomato, curd and water and simmer covered for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Chicken tikka
steps: Marinate chicken cubes in curd, lemon, ginger, garlic and spices for 2 hours.
Skewer and grill at high heat for 12–15 minutes, turning once.

recipes.name: Tandoori chicken
steps: Score the chicken and rub with lemon and salt.
Coat in the spiced curd marinade and rest 4 hours.
Roast at 230 °C for 30–35 minutes.

recipes.name: Rogan josh
steps: Sear mutton in mustard oil with whole spices.
Add whisked curd, chilli, ground fennel and ginger.
Add water and simmer covered until tender, about 75 minutes.

recipes.name: Keema matar
steps: Brown onion with ginger and garlic.
Add mince and cook until it changes colour, then add tomato and spices.
Add peas and a little water and simmer 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Egg curry
steps: Hard-boil and peel the eggs, score lightly.
Cook an onion-tomato masala with spices.
Add water and eggs and simmer 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Egg bhurji
steps: Fry onion and chilli, add tomato and spices.
Pour in beaten eggs and scramble on medium heat.
Finish with coriander.

recipes.name: Roti (phulka)
steps: Knead atta with water into a soft dough and rest 15 minutes.
Roll thin circles and cook on a hot tawa.
Puff directly over the flame.

recipes.name: Roti with ghee
steps: Make phulkas as usual.
Brush each hot roti with half a teaspoon of ghee.

recipes.name: Aloo paratha
steps: Mash boiled potato with onion, chilli, coriander and spices.
Stuff into rounds of atta dough and roll out.
Cook on a tawa with ghee until golden on both sides.

recipes.name: Gobi paratha
steps: Grate cauliflower, salt it and squeeze out the water.
Mix with ginger, chilli and coriander and stuff into the dough.
Roll and cook with ghee.

recipes.name: Paneer paratha
steps: Crumble paneer with onion, chilli, coriander and salt.
Stuff into the dough and roll.
Cook with ghee until golden.

recipes.name: Methi paratha
steps: Knead atta with chopped methi, curd, spices and a little oil.
Roll into thin parathas.
Cook on a tawa with oil.

recipes.name: Plain paratha (lachha)
steps: Knead a soft dough.
Roll, brush with ghee, pleat and coil to make layers.
Roll again and cook with ghee until flaky.

recipes.name: Puri
steps: Knead a stiff dough with a little oil.
Roll small rounds.
Deep-fry until puffed; oil absorbed is about 20% of puri weight.

recipes.name: Bhatura
steps: Knead maida with curd, sugar and salt and rest 2 hours.
Roll into ovals.
Deep-fry until puffed and golden.

recipes.name: Butter naan
steps: Knead maida with curd, milk, sugar and salt and rest 2 hours.
Shape into teardrops and cook in a very hot tandoor or under a grill.
Brush with butter.

recipes.name: Tandoori roti
steps: Knead atta with curd, salt and water and rest.
Shape thick rounds.
Cook in a tandoor or on an inverted tawa.

recipes.name: Missi roti
steps: Knead the flours with onion, chilli and spices.
Roll thick rotis.
Cook on a tawa and brush with ghee.

recipes.name: Makki ki roti
steps: Knead maize flour with warm water.
Pat into rotis between sheets.
Cook slowly on a tawa and top with ghee.

recipes.name: Bajra roti
steps: Knead bajra flour with warm water a portion at a time.
Pat out by hand.
Cook on a tawa and finish over the flame.

recipes.name: Jeera rice
steps: Soak rice for 20 minutes.
Crackle cumin in ghee, add rice and toast briefly.
Add water, cover and cook until fluffy.

recipes.name: Vegetable pulao
steps: Soak rice for 20 minutes.
Fry onion and whole spices in ghee, add vegetables.
Add rice and water and cook covered until done.

recipes.name: Matar pulao
steps: Soak rice.
Temper cumin in ghee, add peas and rice.
Cook with water until fluffy.

recipes.name: Chicken biryani (Lucknowi style)
steps: Marinate chicken in curd, ginger, garlic and spices.
Fry sliced onions until deep brown.
Parboil rice with whole spices.
Layer chicken, rice, onions and mint, seal and cook on dum for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Mutton biryani
steps: Marinate and slow-cook mutton until nearly tender.
Parboil rice with whole spices.
Layer with fried onions and mint, seal and cook on dum for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Vegetable biryani
steps: Marinate the vegetables in curd and spices.
Parboil rice with whole spices.
Layer with fried onion and mint and cook on dum for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Moong dal khichdi
steps: Rinse rice and dal together.
Temper cumin, hing and ginger in ghee.
Add rice, dal, turmeric and 5 cups water and pressure-cook to a soft porridge.

recipes.name: Rice kheer
steps: Simmer milk with rinsed rice, stirring often.
Cook until reduced by about a third and the rice is soft.
Stir in sugar, cardamom and nuts.

recipes.name: Gajar ka halwa
steps: Cook grated carrot in milk until the milk is absorbed.
Add sugar and ghee and cook until glossy.
Stir in khoya, cardamom and nuts.

recipes.name: Sooji halwa
steps: Roast semolina in ghee until fragrant.
Add hot water and stir until thick.
Add sugar, cardamom and nuts and cook until it leaves the pan.

recipes.name: Aloo tikki
steps: Mash boiled potato with peas, cornflour and spices.
Shape patties.
Shallow-fry until crisp.

recipes.name: Samosa
steps: Make a stiff maida dough with oil.
Cook the potato and pea filling with spices.
Shape cones, fill and seal.
Deep-fry on low heat until crisp; oil uptake is about 15% of weight.

recipes.name: Onion pakora
steps: Toss sliced onion with salt and spices.
Add besan and rice flour with a little water.
Drop small clusters into hot oil and fry until crisp.

recipes.name: Paneer bhurji
steps: Fry onion and chilli, add tomato and spices.
Crumble in paneer and toss for 3 minutes.

recipes.name: Chana chaat
steps: Boil soaked chickpeas until tender and cool.
Toss with chopped vegetables, lemon and chaat masala.

recipes.name: Dahi bhalla
steps: Soak and grind urad dal into a fluffy batter.
Fry small vadas and soak them in water, then squeeze.
Top with whisked sweetened curd, tamarind chutney and roasted cumin.

recipes.name: Chole kulche
steps: Boil chickpeas and toss with onion, tomato, lemon and chaat masala.
Make soft maida kulchas and cook on a tawa with butter.
Serve the chole with kulchas.

recipes.name: Sweet lassi
steps: Whisk curd with sugar and a little cold water until frothy.
Serve chilled with cardamom.

recipes.name: Masala chaas
steps: Blend buttermilk with mint, ginger, roasted cumin and salt.
Serve chilled.

recipes.name: Cucumber raita
steps: Whisk curd, fold in grated cucumber.
Season with roasted cumin, salt and mint.

recipes.name: Kashmiri dum aloo
steps: Parboil and fry baby potatoes.
Simmer them in whisked curd with Kashmiri chilli, fennel and dry ginger.
Cook covered until the gravy thickens.

recipes.name: Gatte ki sabzi
steps: Knead besan with spices and a little oil, shape logs and boil 10 minutes.
Slice the gatte.
Cook in a spiced curd gravy for 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Dal baati
steps: Knead a stiff dough with atta, semolina and ghee and bake baatis at 200 °C for 35 minutes.
Cook the mixed dal with turmeric and temper with cumin and tomato.
Dip baatis in ghee and serve with dal.

recipes.name: Aloo sabzi (for puri)
steps: Boil and roughly break the potatoes.
Temper cumin and hing, add tomato and spices.
Add potatoes and water and simmer into a thin gravy.

recipes.name: Palak chicken
steps: Blanch and purée spinach.
Brown onion, ginger and garlic, add chicken and spices and sear.
Add tomato and spinach and simmer until the chicken is cooked.
